_comment: Image models the GPU pod draws for the Studio's painters (paint.py run_comfy). Keys are the model ids of src/studio/models.ts; the painter on the pod advertises backend comfy:<id> once ComfyUI answers and every file in `files` is on disk. Each target is [node id, input]. The settings themselves (steps, CFG, sampler, sigmas, resolution) come with the job from the Studio. lora_after / lora_into: where the painter chains LoraLoaderModelOnly nodes for the job's LoRAs (fetched from their HuggingFace link into models/loras when missing). min_area: a model with a working range (MiniMax-H3-Image: about 4–20 MP) draws a smaller request on a canvas of the same shape scaled up to this many pixels (the job's `resolution`, squared, when it carries one) and the painter resizes the picture back, as MiniMax's own server does (min_generation_area).
